prototype_boundary_statement: This prototype is static HTML/CSS/JS only. It adds local download and support reset controls and keeps feedback counters in page-session memory only. It adds no backend, auth, payment, real download, support system, telemetry, config, feature flag, release, rollback, persistent storage, or external integration.
